Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Introduction
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
 Your Role And Responsibilities
 As a Security Architect, you will be responsible for translating security requirements into an architecture that protects the client's mission and business processes across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. You will oversee the design and implementation of cybersecurity solutions, ensuring they align with industry best practices and the client's unique needs.
 Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include
 IT Security & IT Risk Governance
 Carry out IT and security risk analyses in strict compliance with the IT Risk Management policy to identify and quantify vulnerabilities.
 Optimise and maintain the frameworks and tools used for the identification, assessment, treatment and communication of IT security risks.
 Deploy and enforce BNP Paribas Group security practices and standards across the organisation.
 Project Support & Advisory
 Define risk mitigation strategies for BNPP AM projects and enforce ‘IT Risk & Cybersecurity’ policy requirements to ensure secure operational delivery.
 Integrate security requirements directly into projects to ensure “Security by Design”.
 Review the security profiles of applications within your scope to ensure compliance with the application security baseline.
 Operational Risk Monitoring & Compliance
 Carry out periodic risk reviews and update the IT risk register for assigned areas as part of daily operational monitoring.
 Conduct security audits and due diligence reviews for third-party suppliers, service providers and partners to mitigate supply chain risks.
 Reporting & Performance Management
 Manage and update team KPIs, operational dashboards and activity reports to provide management with precise visibility into the risk landscape and remediation status.
 Design Cybersecurity Solutions: Oversee the design and implementation of cybersecurity solutions that meet industry best practices and the client's unique needs, ensuring alignment with security requirements and business processes.
 Integrate Security into Infrastructure: Play a crucial role in integrating security into the organization's overall infrastructure, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and standards.
 Ensure Security Governance: Develop and implement security governance policies and procedures to ensure effective security management across various security domains, including network security, application security, data security, identity management, and threat management.
 Align with Industry Best Practices: Ensure cybersecurity solutions align with industry best practices, staying up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies to provide effective security solutions.
 Implement Threat Management: Develop and implement threat management strategies to identify, detect, and respond to potential security threats, protecting the client's mission and business processes.
 Preferred Education
 Master's Degree
 Required Technical And Professional Expertise
 Security Architecture Design: Experience with designing and implementing comprehensive security architectures that protect business processes across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, incorporating various security domains such as network security, application security, data security, identity management, and threat management.
 Cybersecurity Solution Development: Experience in developing and implementing cybersecurity solutions that meet industry best practices and unique client needs, ensuring alignment with security requirements and business processes.
 Security Governance and Compliance: Experience with developing and implementing security governance policies and procedures to ensure effective security management and compliance with relevant regulations and standards.
 Threat Management Strategy: Experience in developing and implementing threat management strategies to identify, detect, and respond to potential security threats, protecting the client's mission and business processes.
 Industry Best Practices Alignment: Experience with ensuring cybersecurity solutions align with industry best practices, staying up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies to provide effective security solutions.
 Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
 Deep Understanding of Security Domains: Experience with various security domains, including network security, application security, data security, identity management, threat management, and security governance, to develop comprehensive security architectures.
 Knowledge of Emerging Trends: Exposure to emerging trends and technologies in cybersecurity to stay up-to-date with industry best practices and provide effective security solutions.
 Multi-Cloud Environment Expertise: Experience working with hybrid and multi-cloud environments to design and implement comprehensive security architectures that protect business processes.
